Name: SP_EFFECT_VFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines parameters for visual effects tied to certain SpEffects.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.

Fields.Name: Midst SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect that plays while the effect is active, from the Midst Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Midst SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound that plays while the effect is active, from the Midst Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Start SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the effect activates, from the Start Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Start SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the effect activates, from the Start Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the effect is removed, from the End Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the effect is removed, from the End Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which camouflage starts. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - End Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which camouflage ends. In metres.

Fields.Name: Transform - Protector ID
Fields.Description: Armour piece shown in place of the equipped one while the effect is active. See Is Full Body Protector ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Legacy: Midst Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Old copy of Midst Dummy Poly ID (-1: root) from before the ID range was widened. Kept only for data migration; use Midst Dummy Poly ID.

Fields.Name: Legacy: Start Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Old copy of Start Dummy Poly ID (-1: root) from before the ID range was widened. Kept only for data migration; use Start Dummy Poly ID.

Fields.Name: Legacy: End Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Old copy of End Dummy Poly ID (-1: root) from before the ID range was widened. Kept only for data migration; use End Dummy Poly ID.

Fields.Name: Effect Type
Fields.Description: Effect type

Fields.Name: Weapon Enchant - Soul Param ID
Fields.Description: Soul param ID for weapon enchants. Changes the phantom param that is applied.

Fields.Name: Play Category
Fields.Description: Controls playback when several effects overlap: of the effects in the same category, only the one with the best Play Priority plays.

Fields.Name: Play Priority
Fields.Description: Playback priority when the Play Category matches. Lower values take priority.

Fields.Name: Large Effect Exists
Fields.Description: If ON, a separate effect exists for large characters.

Fields.Name: Soul Effect Exists
Fields.Description: If ON, a separate effect exists for the soul body.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Invisible while Active
Fields.Description: If ON, this effect is hidden while the character is camouflaged.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Enable
Fields.Description: If ON, the character is camouflaged (see the camouflage distances and Min Alpha).

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Invisible for Friend
Fields.Description: If ON, the camouflaged character is hidden from allies as well.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Keep Foot SFX
Fields.Description: Set this to keep foot particle effects visible while the character is camouflaged.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Translucent Appearance
Fields.Description: If ON, camouflage only makes the character translucent.

Fields.Name: Is Full Body Protector ID
Fields.Description: If ON, the Transform - Protector ID covers the whole body.

Fields.Name: Is Invisible Weapon
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: if ON, the weapon model is hidden. 0: weapon shown. 1: weapon hidden.

Fields.Name: Is Silent
Fields.Description: If ON, the character is silent while the effect is active.

Fields.Name: Is Midst SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: If ON, the Midst SFX plays from the full-body equipment dummy polys: torso 190, head 191, hands 192, legs 193.

Fields.Name: Is Start SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: If ON, the Start SFX plays from the full-body equipment dummy polys: torso 190, head 191, hands 192, legs 193.

Fields.Name: Is End SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: If ON, the End SFX plays from the full-body equipment dummy polys: torso 190, head 191, hands 192, legs 193.

Fields.Name: Is Visible on Dead Character
Fields.Description: If ON, the VFX is still shown while the character is dead.

Fields.Name: Use Enchant SFX Size to Offset SFX ID
Fields.Description: If ON, the SFX ID is offset by the weapon param's Enchant SFX Size.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Keep Muzzle Flash SFX
Fields.Description: Set this to keep muzzle flash particle effects visible while the character is camouflaged.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [0]
Fields.Description: Decal placed by the effect. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [1]
Fields.Description: Second decal placed by the effect. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Priority
Fields.Description: Priority of the foot effect offset. Lower values take priority.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Offset
Fields.Description: Amount added to the foot effect ID while this SpEffect is active.

Fields.Name: Trace SFX ID Offset Type
Fields.Description: Offset applied to the weapon trail (slash) SFX ID. Used for enchant and blade trail effects.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 1, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 1. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [1]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 2, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [1]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 2. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [2]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 3, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [2]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 3. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [3]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 4, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [3]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 4. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [4]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 5, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [4]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 5. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [5]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 6, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [5]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 6. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [6]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 7, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [6]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 7. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [7]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the base of enchant trail 8, where the enchant SFX is generated.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [7]
Fields.Description: Weapon dummy poly at the tip of enchant trail 8. -1: automatically runs up to the end of the consecutively numbered dummy polys.

Fields.Name: SFX ID Offset Type
Fields.Description: SfxID offset type

Fields.Name: Phantom Param Overwrite Type
Fields.Description: How the phantom param is forcibly overwritten while the effect is active.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Min Alpha
Fields.Description: Minimum opacity of the character while camouflaged. In percent.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Keep While Locked On
Fields.Description: If ON, the character stays camouflaged even while it is locked on to.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param Overwrite ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row forced on the character, used with Phantom Param Overwrite Type.

Fields.Name: Material Param ID
Fields.Description: Material parameter changed on the character while the effect is active. 0-99: built-in parameters; 100 and up: a MaterialExParam row. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material Param - Start Fade
Fields.Description: The value at the start of the fade of the material parameter. The target is specified by the material parameter ID. If the material parameter ID is -1, do nothing

Fields.Name: Material Param - End Fade
Fields.Description: The value at the end of the fade of the material parameter. The target is specified by the material parameter ID. If the material parameter ID is -1, do nothing

Fields.Name: Material Param - Fade Time
Fields.Description: Fade time for material parameter values. Gradually reach the target value over this time. If the material parameter ID is -1, do nothing

Fields.Name: Display Marker ID
Fields.Description: While the effect is active, the marker with this ID is shown.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Re-enable Grace Time
Fields.Description: Grace time before camouflage takes hold again after it was cancelled and then re-enabled. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Additional Equipment Protector ID
Fields.Description: Extra armour piece equipped by the effect. It stays equipped after the SpEffect ends.

Fields.Name: SFX Scale: X
Fields.Description: Scale of the effect on the X-axis.

Fields.Name: SFX Scale: Y
Fields.Description: Scale of the effect on the Y-axis.

Fields.Name: SFX Scale: Z
Fields.Description: Scale of the effect on the Z-axis.

Fields.Name: Midst Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the Midst SFX and SE play from. -1: the character's root.

Fields.Name: Start Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the Start SFX and SE play from. -1: the character's root.

Fields.Name: End Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the End SFX and SE play from. -1: the character's root.
